name: Oozora Kiku
source:
The eldest of the three Oozora sisters. She is in charge of sexiness, just as she appears to be.

In this work, she is very active in the west and the east, just like an eldest daughter.

She is one of the mascot's from Otenki Studio. She is 26 years old.

[From [url=https://www.konbuni.com/nangoku.html]official site[/url]]
